_doc: Bot cycle 47+: grixis_refine v2 output. Recommendations only: never a final list, never written to deck pages or exports. Always exploratory: M2+M4 acceptance opens the M6 gate (Cory constraint 6) but approves no refinement result (t52u); M6 decisions need a judgment_review. lift_check.note: Confirmed in the cached EDHREC commander JSON: each cardview carries synergy, lift, num_decks, potential_decks and trend_zscore. No fetch timestamp in the payload, so retrieval date = cache file mtime (UTC date).
